summary: Ex-parte decree in specific performance suit; delay condonation vs setting aside decree as distinct remedies; High Court improperly set aside decree without challenge to dismissal of I.A. No. 1163; condonation of delay upheld but setting aside decree quashed; Trial Court directed to hear application on merits; jurisdictional error in High Court's conflation of separate procedural issues.
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; High Court order condoning delay upheld but setting aside ex-parte decree set aside; I.A. No. 1163 restored for hearing on merits.
